text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hraaaaagh! Princess coming through!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay, I did it! Another beautiful,
graceful, courageous day—and a
big win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You've got that right! It's all because—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—I've got my fateful partner!
The prince of
my future is with me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The moment we bonded there was a big
bang of a miracle! That's the
real power of
a bond!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about that! I learned it
all from Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wherever it came from, confidence is
always a good thing. So long as
she can
keep this up—

Hmph. It seems I've finally found you,
would-be princess. Or should I
say,
overconfident commoner?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "would-be"?! And who
are you?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Heh... Can you not tell by my aura brimming with princess spirit? I'm the real princess here! And the strongest too—my princess power is over 100 billion!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what your level is! I'm a
fantastic princess! I even found
my prince!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A prince, you say? You don't mean
that trainer there, do you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You're so plain, I didn't even
notice you! Like a paltry piece
of carrot in
cheap instant noodles!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
M-my trainer is nothing of the sort! My
trainer's like, um... wagyu
steak topped
with caviar—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Heh... If you're so mad about it, why don't you race me and make me shut up? I'll personally show you what a real princess can do!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was about to say the same thing! You'll
take back those words once I
beat the
daylights out of you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(I've seen this Umamusume before. She's a
veteran with some serious
Twinkle Series
wins under her belt!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry!
There's no way I'd lose to
a bully like that. I'll leave
her in my dust
and win the race in time for tea!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on. You worry way too much! I
don't need any tactics or
anything!
Because...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We've got the invincible power of our
bond! Just trust it and wait for
my return!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My attempts to stop her go unheard. Maybe she's gotten a little too confident...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I've got a good pace now! Time to
cut straight through to the
finish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess is running in top form
like usual, but the
curly-haired rival
princess is trailing eerily close behind
her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Are you all talk, Kawakami? What
do you think a princess is?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I know exactly what a princess is!
Beautiful, graceful, and
courageous...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, mwahahaha! Don't make me
laugh! Here, I'll tell you
something useful!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
It's the undeniable, overwhelming power
to crush those beneath
you—that's what
makes a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Aaahahahaha! If you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami tries desperately to catch up,
but by the end, she finishes
three lengths
behind.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ugh, why?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh, aaahahahagh! Cough, cough! This is the difference between a real princess... and a fake!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaah! It's not faaair!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess runs off before I even
have a chance to console
her...
